ttc_sampling_contract.equilibrium_assumptions: Time homogeneous stable Gaussian AR(1); initial equilibrium uncertainty independent of subsequent innovations; tensor quadrature approximates the declared law.

scenario_precision_contract.rule: Round derived relative-index factors to twelve decimal places before binding and sealing; bank-supplied contract amounts are not rounded.
scenario_precision_contract.purpose: Explicit common scenario-grid precision, separate from unrounded native model fitting.
scenario_precision_contract.lessee_probability_rule: Actual native scorecard and holdout calibration predictions are rounded to eight decimal places for the frozen counterparty contract; unrounded estimates are checked against binomial group algebra within 1e-8.

metadata.population_definition: Independent synthetic equipment lessees, holdout frequency counts
metadata.outcome_policy: Fully mature observed obligor default over one year

guarantee_convention.dependence: Guarantor event independent of macro/lessee path under this explicit synthetic law; actual path borrower default is conditioned, never an empirical label.
guarantee_convention.payout_timing: First-default-date payment of capped economic loss measured at that date; no second recovery of already-valued collateral.
guarantee_convention.cap_convention: One facility per mutually exclusive scenario; non-reinstating cap; no second claim. No promise that bank contracts have this convention.
